messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT detected -> p95/p99 spike on inference API (streaming) in us-west-2, routing -> eng-sre paging. Alerts: increased tail latency, streaming stalls, higher 5xx on config-fetch and auth calls. Automated severity: P1.
Emma W: acked — joining bridge. quick snapshot: p95 ~ 1.8s -> 3.6s, p99 ~ 4s -> 9.2s, streaming session failures up ~ 6%.
Omar R: seeing backend traces: a spike of auth service latencies to 500-800ms, config-store 502s for some requests; KV cache hit ratio dropped. Could be a DB read amplification.
Lina K: infra note: DB read replicas saw a burst of queries at ~11:07UTC, CPU on two read nodes ~95%. Nothing else anomalous at infra layer yet.
Mike (oncall): are customer-facing routes impacted? which tenants?
Emma W: partial. Top affected: streaming/chat endpoints and long-polling eval jobs. A subset of heavy tenants show more stalls — likely due to long prompts + repeated config fetches.
Ben P: any user-visible errors? Support reports: websocket disconnect + resumed reconnects, some clients reported reorders. ETA for mitigation?
Omar R: hypothesis: feature flags/config fetch loop per request for unknown reason; we're also hitting per-customer rate-limiting code path in control-plane which queues requests, increasing tail latency.
Celia (sre-lead): set up a quick mitigation plan: 1) pause expensive config fetches by flipping fallback flag -> return cached config; 2) temporarily relax control-plane per-customer soft-rates/queue depth; 3) scale auth replicas and add read replica for config DB; 4) route streaming traffic to dedicated pool if possible. Who can flip feature flag?
Emma W: I can flip FF. Doing: `curl -X POST https://controlplane/flags/fetch-remote -d '{"state":"fallback"}'` -> flipping now.
dash-bot: feature-flag-change: fetch-remote -> fallback by Emma W at 2026-03-15T11:12:05Z.
Omar R: observed immediate drop in config-store traffic. KV cache hit ratio recovering.
Lina K: spinning up one extra read replica, and bumping auth svc replicas + horizontal autoscaler target. Starting now, ETA ~3-4min.
Mike (oncall): temporary rate-limit relax — how do we do that without exploding backend?
Celia (sre-lead): change is soft: increase per-customer in-flight from 50 -> 80 and backpressure threshold from 0.7 -> 0.85. Omar, can you apply a scoped rollout?
Omar R: applying scoped change to control-plane (canary customers excluded) via admin console. Pushing change.
dash-bot: controlplane-rate-update: in-flight thresholds adjusted by Omar R at 2026-03-15T11:14:30Z.
Emma W: p95 dropped from 3.6s -> 2.2s after flag flip and initial relax. p99 still elevated ~6.1s but trending down. Streaming stalls reduced from 6% -> 2.1%.
Ben P: customers to notify? Any who saw errors?"
Mike (oncall): FYI sent to support with templated note: we are experiencing a control-plane impairment impacting streaming/long-tail latency; mitigations in progress, no data lost.
Emma W: also throttles in some API gateways were hitting per-client windows — I temporarily disabled token-window enforcement for a handful of heavy keys.
Omar R: added extra auth replicas are up. Auth p95 down to ~120ms from 600ms. Config-store 5xx reduced to near zero.
Celia (sre-lead): good. set incident phase -> mitigation. Next: monitor for 30m, prepare rollback plan for flag flip, and schedule postmortem. Owner for postmortem?
Emma W: I will take postmortem owner. Tasks: correlate requests that triggered config fetch, why cache misses spiked, and why rate-limit queuing amplified latencies.
Lina K: infra follow-up: run a read-replica perf check, check slow queries on config DB, heap/GC on config-sidecar pods.
Ben P: product will reach out to top-5 affected customers with a summary and ETA for RCA.
Mike (oncall): handing off to night oncall in 45m. If metrics re-regress, wake me and escalate.
Celia (sre-lead): marking incident as mitigated. Keep this thread for updates. Postmortem in three days, include runbook gaps for per-customer rate limiting.
Emma W: logging final numbers: current p95 220ms, p99 680ms, streaming stalls ~0.8% — closing bridge.
dash-bot: incident-closed: mitigation in place, severity downgraded to P2 at 2026-03-15T11:28:50Z.
Mike (oncall): thanks team — please add notes to the incident tracker and link any relevant traces.
Celia (sre-lead): noted. Action items assigned: Emma (postmortem), Omar (control-plane rate logic audit), Lina (config DB slow query fixes), Ben (customer comms).
Emma W: adding timeline + initial graphs to the incident doc now.
